concerns.text: The power analysis (Section 3.2 of research.md) estimates required sample size using a trial‑level effect size (f = 0.15) and assumes independent observations (N ≈ 300 trials). Because the primary analysis is a linear mixed‑effects model with repeated measures per participant, trial‑level counts overstate the effective sample size; power should be computed based on the number of participants (and the random‑effects structure) or via simulation. Relying on the current power calculation may lead to a false “Power Limitation” flag and mis‑interpretation of adequacy.
